name: Elune's Tear
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I had hoped Orendil's cure would save Relara, but I fear it only slowed the disease running through my child.  We must find more powerful medicine!  Thankfully, Orendil spoke to me of further remedies to try should his first one fail.

Elune's Tear is a type of stone that rests in only one place: the isle on Iris Lake, east of Astranaar.  Orendil said the stone will wash away corruption... please, adventurer, bring me Elune's Tear and pray it will end my child's sickness!
narrative.objectives: Bring Elune's Tear to Pelturas in Astranaar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Oh, you found it! I will place the tear in a stew, and pray that it will cure her.

Thank you! Thank you, adventurer!
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer, did you find Iris Lake? Do you have the Tear?
